name: Azeroth Companion
title: SOVEREIGN ROUTE ARCHITECT — Interactive Atlas Expedition Itineraries
approval_note: Owner requested continued Azeroth development after v18 World Atlas. Physical-device and real World of Warcraft account/gameplay acceptance remains pending.
features: World Atlas v18.1 Sovereign Route Architect: create up to six private named expedition itineraries containing up to twelve curated locations each.
Select destination map pins and display numbered route markers and illustrative intra-region line connections; route ordering is never misrepresented as official in-game travel guidance.
Mark personal visits, save bounded research notes, reorder stops and view matching manual Atlas missions, with links into Expedition Intelligence and v17 Adventure Operations.
Curated route starter sets for capital research, Dragon Isles and Khaz Algar; optional grouping by research region with no travel-time claims.
Portable export/import, confirmation before replacement, cross-tab overwrite protection and complete Save Protection coverage for the single new v18.1 key.
Polished desktop/iPhone layouts with reduced-motion support; older saved missions, bookmarks, character builds, account connection, Cloudflare Worker and existing site remain unchanged.
